title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Billing-Error Correction Credits on the Protection Fee Ledger
content:
A protection fee charge posted in billing error on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan is corrected by a billing-error credit on the plan's fee ledger, posted against the charge in error. A billing-error correction is credited whatever the plan's enrollment date, because the free-look limit governs only free-look refunds.

## What the correction does on the records

Posting the correction adds a fee-ledger credit of the kind billing-error correction, dated the day it is posted, that references the protection fee charge being corrected, and lowers the plan's protection fee balance by the amount credited. A negative fee balance is a credit the tenant holds on the plan. Once posted, the billing-error credit is visible on the plan's fee ledger against the charge it corrects.

## Function: `credit_protection_fee_error_2320aa46`

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side function of the care center console. The agent unlocks `credit_protection_fee_error_2320aa46` and then calls it; the agent handles it, and the customer runs nothing.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | the tenant protection plan number whose fee ledger is credited, as returned by the plan lookup | identifier text |
| `reference_entry_id` | the reference number of the protection fee charge entry being corrected, as returned by the fee ledger lookup | identifier text |
| `amount` | the credit posted, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

The kind of credit is not a parameter: every credit this function posts is of the kind `billing_error_correction`.

**Return.** A receipt with: `premium_entry_id` (the reference number of the credit entry), `plan_id` (the plan credited), `reference_entry_id` (the fee charge corrected), `credit_type` (always `billing_error_correction`), `amount` (the credit posted, USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `premium_balance_due` (the plan's fee balance after the credit, USD, 2 decimal places, negative when in credit).

## Illustration (hypothetical input and receipt)

A call with `plan_id` set to a plan number, `reference_entry_id` set to a fee charge's reference number and `amount` 15.00 returns a receipt whose `credit_type` is `billing_error_correction`, whose `amount` is 15.00 and whose `premium_balance_due` is the plan's former fee balance less 15.00 — for a plan whose balance stood at 0.00, a balance of -15.00, a credit the tenant holds.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the enrollment date limit a billing-error correction?** No. The free-look limit governs only free-look refunds; a billing-error correction is credited whatever the plan's enrollment date.
